name: VRM_PRICING_BANDS
description: VRM_PRICING_BANDS contains the pricing dimension bands.

columns.name: PRICING_BAND_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the pricing dimension band.

columns.name: SEGMENT_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Pricing dimension segment value that represents the bands.

columns.name: BAND_HIGH_VALUE
columns.description: High price of the pricing dimension band.

columns.name: BAND_LOW_VALUE
columns.description: Low price of the pricing dimension band.

columns.name: MAPPING_SET_VALUE
columns.description: Mapping set value that is used to form a group. For example, the column will store country codes for all the EU zone countries.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PRICING_BAND_HDR_ID
columns.description: Pricing band line internal identifier.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE_DESC
columns.description: Description of the pricing band.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the pricing band.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the pricing band.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the pricing band.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
